[sonic_dump_arc-switch1025_20210419_080448.tar.gz](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/files/6334381/sonic_dump_arc-switch1025_20210419_080448.tar.gz)

#### Description

Interface MAC is overwriten by systemd udev-rules, specifically /usr/lib/systemd/network/99-default.link:

```
[Match]
OriginalName=*

[Link]
NamePolicy=keep kernel database onboard slot path
AlternativeNamesPolicy=database onboard slot path
MACAddressPolicy=persistent
```

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run this script in teamd container (autorestart of teamd container is disabled)

```
#!/bin/bash
while :; do
        pkill -9 teamd;
        ip link del PortChannel100 ;
        rm -rf /var/run/teamd/PortChannel100.pid;
        /usr/bin/teamd -r -t PortChannel100 -c '{"device":"PortChannel100","hwaddr":"<IPV6>","runner":{"active":true,"name":"lacp"}}' -L /var/warmboot/teamd/ -g -d ;
        ip link set dev PortChannel100 up ;
        ip link show PortChannel100;
        ip link show PortChannel100 | grep '7c:fe' || { echo "!!!!Reproduced!!!!"; exit 1; }
done
```

#### Describe the results you received:

```
root@arc-switch1025:/# bash -x ./test.sh
+ :
+ pkill -9 teamd
+ ip link del PortChannel100
Cannot find device "PortChannel100"
+ rm -rf /var/run/teamd/PortChannel100.pid
+ /usr/bin/teamd -r -t PortChannel100 -c '{"device":"PortChannel100","hwaddr":"<IPV6>","runner":{"active":true,"name":"lacp"}}' -L /var/warmboot/teamd/ -g -d
Using team device "PortChannel100".
Using PID file "/var/run/teamd/PortChannel100.pid"
This program is not intended to be run as root.
+ ip link set dev PortChannel100 up
+ ip link show PortChannel100
173: PortChannel100: <NO-CARRIER,BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP> mtu 1500 qdisc noqueue state DOWN mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether <IPV6> brd <IPV6>
+ ip link show PortChannel100
+ grep 7c:fe
+ echo '!!!!Reproduced!!!!'
!!!!Reproduced!!!!
+ exit 1

```

#### Describe the results you expected:

Interface MAC should be a router MAC from DEVICE_METADATA.

resolution.title: [systemd] disable default systemd udev rules for interfaces
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
Fix #7364

99-default.link - was always in SONiC, but previous systemd (<247) had an issue and it did not work due to issue systemd/systemd#3374. Now systemd 247 works.

However, such policy overrides teamd provided mac address which causes teamd netdev to use a random mac
address. Therefore, needs to be disabled.

#### How I did it
Disable default systemd udev rules for interfaces.

#### How to verify it

Execute https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/7364 reproduction script.
